code_summary: One independently trained candidate-conditioned ItemAttention network per category, with four-category predictor routing and one selected checkpoint loaded per category. History and candidate embeddings share one table. Learned key/query projections produce attention over history with learned recency decay; normalized pooled history and candidate embeddings yield scaled cosine scores plus a jointly trained item bias. Training uses sampled prefix targets, training-only unseen negatives, cross-entropy, AdamW, and validation HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 as a tie-breaker. No ensemble or checkpoint averaging is implemented.
